messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished to apac1: service/inference v2.33.0 -> v2.34.0 (rollout 10%). commit b1c2d3. canary probes started.

ella: Heads-up — synthetic embedding probe started returning intermittent 502/503 on apac1 ~+70s post-rollout, not across all hosts.

sre-raj: Per-host breakdown: apac1-node-2 and apac1-node-5 show fd counts spiking, accept queue drops, and higher CLOSE_WAIT. no pod restarts.

ops-miguel: Pause rollout and pin region to previous release. Quarantine suspect hosts from LB instead of full rollback.

release-amy: Pausing rollout now. No further batches.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by release-amy. Route change queued.

ops-miguel: Applied route change: apac1 -> release:v2.33.0 (effective 09:40Z). Quarantined apac1-node-2 and apac1-node-5; scheduled quick restart and proc-level FD dump.

ella: Re-ran synth after diversion — embed errors dropped to baseline within 30s. No customer 5xx reported. Captured lsof showing many sockets stuck in CLOSE_WAIT on node-2/5.

sre-raj: Filing INF-4600 for RCA: initial hypothesis is a file-descriptor leak in the new worker under keepalive; plan = fd dump, repro load, and a tiny canary with lsof sampling for first 3m.

release-amy: Noted. Marking release as "paused - apac1 reverted" and adding INF-4600 to release actions with owner=@sre-raj. We'll retest after patch and extra probe coverage. Closing thread for now.
